message.content:
Yes—Atlanta residents can file noise complaints through the city’s official channels. Noise violations are generally handled by the **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** or the **Atlanta Police Department**, depending on the severity and location of the disturbance. ### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where to Go | |------|------------|-------------| | 1 | **Identify the source** – Determine whether the noise is coming from a residential, commercial, or public property. | — | | 2 | **Check the ordinance** – Review Atlanta’s *Noise Ordinance* (Title 10, Chapter 5 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) to confirm the violation and applicable penalties. | [Atlanta Municipal Code – Noise Ordinance](https://www.atlantaga.gov/CodeEnforcement/NoiseOrdinance) | | 3 | **Gather details** – Note the time, date, location, and description of the noise. If possible, record audio or video evidence. | — | | 4 | **Contact the appropriate agency** | • **Code Enforcement** (for ongoing or repeated violations)
• **Police Department** (for immediate safety concerns or illegal activity) | | 5 | **File the complaint** | • **Online**: Use the City of Atlanta’s “Report a Problem” portal.
• **Phone**: Call 404‑656‑4000 (Atlanta Police) or 404‑656‑4000 (Code Enforcement).
• **In person**: Visit the nearest Code Enforcement office. | | 6 | **Follow up** | Keep a copy of your complaint receipt and any reference number. Follow up if you don’t receive a response within a reasonable timeframe. | #### Online Filing (Recommended) 1. Go to the City of Atlanta’s **“Report a Problem”** portal: https://www.atlantaga.gov/CodeEnforcement/ReportAProblem 2. Select **“Noise Complaint”** from the list of issue types. 3. Fill out the form with the required details and attach any evidence. 4. Submit the form; you’ll receive a confirmation email with a reference number. #### Phone Filing - **Atlanta Police Department**: 404‑656‑4000 (24/7 hotline for emergencies) - **Code Enforcement**: 404‑656‑4000 (calls are forwarded to the appropriate department) #### In-Person Filing - **Code Enforcement Office**: 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30308 ### Tips & Best Practices - **Document everything**: Time stamps, dates, and any recordings help substantiate your claim. - **Be polite but firm**: When speaking to officials, clearly state the problem and its impact on your quality of life. - **Know the ordinance**: Familiarize yourself with the specific noise limits (e.g., 70 dB during daytime, 60 dB at night) so you can reference them when filing. - **Escalate if necessary**: If the initial complaint isn’t resolved, you can request a follow‑up inspection or seek mediation through the city’s community liaison office. ### Quick Reference | Resource | Link | |----------|------| | Atlanta Municipal Code – Noise Ordinance | https://www.atlantaga.gov/CodeEnforcement/NoiseOrdinance | | Report a Problem Portal | https://www.atlantaga.gov/CodeEnforcement/ReportAProblem | | Atlanta Police Hotline | 404‑656‑4000 | | Code Enforcement Contact | 404‑656‑4000 | By following these steps, you can effectively report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta and have it addressed by the proper authorities.
